stories.title: Trump tells the UN the US 'totally rejects' a globalist scheme to control AI, rebrands it 'superintelligence'
stories.reason: In his UN General Assembly address, Trump rejected calls for international oversight or a development slowdown, framing AI regulation efforts as a 'globalist' threat and directing the US government to adopt the term 'superintelligence' going forward.

stories.title: UN Security Council holds first-ever joint session with OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek and Moonshot on AI risks
stories.reason: Sam Altman is set to appear in person and Anthropic remotely alongside Chinese rivals DeepSeek and Moonshot, marking the first time the Council has directly convened leading US and Chinese AI developers together to discuss shared safety standards.

stories.title: Rubio to meet Russia's Lavrov in New York as US pushes to revive Ukraine peace efforts
stories.reason: The sidelines meeting during UN General Assembly week is the two top diplomats' first sit-down since July, coming as Moscow escalates missile strikes on Ukrainian industry and Kyiv seeks US backing for a mutual halt on energy-infrastructure attacks.

stories.title: Russian missile barrage kills four and cuts power to nearly 100,000 across Ukraine's industrial heartland
stories.reason: Moscow fired 212 drones, cruise missiles and Oniks anti-ship missiles at Dnipro, Kryvyi Rih and Pavlohrad overnight, striking Ukraine's largest pipe producer and hitting 13 regions in total just as Zelensky arrived in New York for talks with Trump.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian heads to the UN vowing to expose 'oppression' of Iranians in the US-Israeli war
stories.reason: Pezeshkian's address to the General Assembly, an unusual appearance by the leader of a country still at war with Washington, comes as Bessent's sweeping new airline sanctions take effect and Trump weighs whether to escalate militarily or strike a deal.

stories.title: Morocco holds parliamentary elections as 28 parties compete for 395 seats
stories.reason: The vote, held with roughly 2.2 million fewer registered voters than in 2021, will shape the next government and comes as Akhannouch's National Rally of Independents has already struck a coalition deal with the Istiqlal and Authenticity and Modernity parties.

stories.title: Alphabet's Intrinsic open-sources its core industrial robotics platform under Apache 2.0
stories.reason: Intrinsic Core bundles real-time hardware-agnostic control, Nvidia FoundationPose-based pose estimation and motion and grasp planning, a move Forbes likened to giving away 'the Android of robotics' as Alphabet races to seed the physical-AI ecosystem.

stories.title: Dollar hits near three-month high as hawkish Fed signals continue to ripple through markets
stories.reason: The dollar index climbed near 100.5 after the Fed's first rate hike since 2023 and projections that four officials favor a second increase this year, tightening financial conditions further as futures markets now price a 4.2% policy rate by December.
